content.text:
I've changed the prompts for both problems and committed the fix as `43a1e8ce`, but I haven't tested it on a real call yet. Unit tests (1201 passed) and lint pass.

## The problems and their causes

**1. Coming back after you interrupt it.** When you talk over a result, the app later asks the model to finish it. The instruction said "finish the part you hadn't said yet, without repeating", and nothing about how to restart. So it jumped back into the middle of the answer with no "anyway, back to…" line.

**2. Going to "Listening" between answers.** The app gives the model one result at a time. An earlier change (`28d02b97`) added this to every result: *"Say only this… you'll be told what is still running."* That tells the model to say the one result, stop, and wait to be told more. So after each answer it ended its turn. The app then waited 1.2 s of silence before handing over the next result, plus however long the model took to start talking. That gap is the "Listening" you see.

## The fix
All changes are in `lib/ai/voice-call-controller.ts`:
- **Resume:** before finishing a cut-off result, the model now first says in a few words that it's going back to it (e.g. "Anyway, back to your September spending…").
- **Each result's instruction:** it now says to give this result without ending on a question or waiting for you, and to go straight on to the next result if one comes.
- **Pause before the next result:** cut from 1.2 s to 0.7 s when your mic has been quiet.

There may still be a short gap between results, because the model takes a moment to start each one. Try a call with two or three questions at once, and with an interruption, to check both fixes.

content.text: Re-running the full suite to check the one failure.

The orb should now stay on "Moneo is talking" between results, and the next result goes out after 0.3 s of quiet instead of 0.7 s. Committed as `f417fbd5`, but not yet tried on a real call.

**Why it kept switching to Listening:** the orb only showed "talking" while Moneo's voice could actually be heard. Between two results Moneo is briefly silent, and so is the model while it gets ready to say the next one. Every result had already finished, so the orb didn't show "Working on it" either, and it fell back to "Listening".

**What changed:**
- **The orb:** it now also stays on talking while a result is waiting to be said, or has been handed over but not started yet. It only switches to Listening once there's nothing left for Moneo to say.
- **The 0.3 s pause:** setting it to 0.3 s alone wasn't enough. A separate 0.7 s check on whether anyone is talking was also holding each result back, so I made that check look only at you, not at Moneo. Moneo's own silence now uses the 0.3 s timer.

At 0.3 s, a short pause in the middle of Moneo's sentence could be mistaken for the end of a result, and the next one would start too early. If you hear that on a call, about 0.5 s is a safer value.

Unit tests (1201) and lint pass. The first full test run had one failure, which went away when I reran it. I didn't keep its output, so I don't know which test it was.
